items.text: I'm sorry to have to say this, but…
Look, it's a bit awkward, but I'm afraid there's something I'm not happy about.
Sorry to bother you, but I've got a problem with…
It would really help if you could…

steps.title: Три шага жалобы
steps.html:
ШагЧто говоритеЗачем
1Sorry to bother you, but… / I'm sorry to have to say this, but…предупреждает до сути
2факты одним предложением, без прилагательныхс фактами трудно спорить
3Would you mind …ing? / It would really help if you could…говорит, чего вы хотите
—Do you think you could get the manager?следующий шаг, если ответ «нет»

steps.title: Две грамматические детали внутри фраз
steps.html:
Would you mind + -ing? — глагол в форме -ing, а ответ обманчив: No, not at all значит «да, сделаю».

It would really help if you could… использует нереальное условие из юнита 8, чтобы смягчить просьбу. Ситуация реальная — вежливость создаёт именно грамматика.

В онлайн-обсуждении смягчение делается коротким согласием: I see your point, but…, That's a fair point, although…

Скажите позицию, одну причину и один аргумент противоположной стороны.

steps.title: Прочитайте обсуждение. Трое, одно решение галереи.
steps.html:
Aigul T. 3h · City Gallery discussion

So the gallery has taken the labels off every painting in the main room. In my view this is exactly right. I spent forty minutes there on Saturday and I actually looked at the pictures instead of reading about them. The room next door still has labels, and I watched three people read the card, glance at the painting for two seconds and move on. That's not looking; that's filing.

Daniyar 2h · replying to Aigul T.

I see your point, but some of us don't have your background. Without a label I can't tell whether I'm looking at something from 1650 or 1980, and that changes what the painting is doing. I'd have to disagree that reading first is always lazy — sometimes it's the only way in.

Aigul T. 1h · replying to Daniyar

That's a fair point, and I hadn't thought about it that way. But the gallery hasn't removed the information — it's on a card at the door and on the website. Would you mind trying it once without the label and telling me whether it changed anything? I'd genuinely like to know.

#CityGallery

steps.html:
1. 1 · Обозначьте позицию через In my view или I'd say.

  4. 4 · Возразите там, где не согласны: I'd have to disagree that…
